WITH customer_states AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.state_county_province
  FROM Customers c
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Accounts a
    WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  )
), state_counts AS (
  SELECT state_county_province, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM customer_states
  GROUP BY state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         customer_count,
         1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
), scored_states AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         customer_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored_states
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A customer with a NULL state/province is grouped with all other customers whose state/province is NULL; the state counts and shares include only customers with at least one account.
